notes.title: Big Update for the Playtest and Upcoming Demo!
notes.notes: [h1]Hillshade Farm┃Big Update for the Playtest, Demo Release announcement![/h1][p][/p][p][i]Hi everyone![/i][/p][p][i]It’s been a while since the last news drop, but it’s been busy behind the scenes! Fixing, polishing, and adding a ton of new content to Hillshade Farm.[/i] [/p][p][b]Today[/b] we’re launching a [b]massive update for the Playtest[/b], and we’re thrilled to announce that the [b]free demo will be available in just one week![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🌟 Biggest Additions[/h1][p][i]This update is more than just fixes, it’s a major leap forward. Here are some of the highlights you’ll notice right away:[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Farm Task System[/b] [/h2][p]Introducing structured farming life! The demo will feature [b]7 handcrafted tasks[/b] to guide you through planting, harvesting and more, giving purpose and flow to your farming journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/cadfc61d1daf1e12fa962ce7b2b317acf5e60b10.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/029282f369758c4f9b43254199591243e23f4c54.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]☀️ New Area: The Vista Diner[/b] [/h2][p]A beautiful cliffside restaurant where you can [b]sell your products, [/b]meet people, take on quests or simply enjoy the breath-taking views! This is the first of several unique destinations coming to the farm world![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/629b899322aa13b69c37cebf79861fa730fa7f95.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/4cab70e5d5d755d4ce179d7d9470001ff07ce7a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🧑‍🌾 Vista Farmer’s Stand[/b][/h2][p][i]New place to sell! Here you can sell a bigger variety of items, mostly crafted items and high-value               fruits. Prices are much higher than selling from the Farm directly. [/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/0c840f092565ed1b69d015aa2532fab9caf4cfe8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/9e286890258ce20b556f90fa5bbe8a77d3857f22.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🧔 NPCs Arrive[/b] [/h2][p]1st iteration of NPCs now inhabit some of the locations, ready to talk, interact, and bring life to the Valley. Some will even offer you quests and tasks in future builds![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/d444752e1ea093e0b5ffef38964e531ad042db2e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🌍 World Visual Overhaul[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The entire map has been improved with richer details, better lighting, and a more immersive environment. Check out screenshots below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/7e94988fa069234e71944a91b8b059c5fa9779d9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/8192492e3391314ac907790353ff255042079acd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/8542f301981f110917738e9642f05aae289a34e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🌾 Major Improvements[/h1][p][/p][p]Alongside the new systems and world overhaul, we’ve polished almost every other part of the game:[/p][list][*][p][b]Countless bug fixes[/b] - thanks to your Playtest feedback, and further developer testing we’ve squashed a [i]mountain[/i] of issues from the first version![/p][/*][*][p][b]Shops Overhauled[/b] – the [b]Farmer’s Store[/b] and [b]Animal Market[/b] are clearer, more polished, and more rewarding to use. [/p][/*][*][p][b]SFX & Sound Design[/b] – tons of new audio! Ambience, music, tools, people, animals, interactions and much more! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall polish across the board[/b] – UI tweaks, interaction smoothing, pacing improvements, and small touches everywhere![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Noteworthy mention:[/i][/p][h3][b]🗲 AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution (FSR)[/b] [/h3][p]Hillshade Farm has implemented [b]FSR upscaling technology[/b], letting you [b]boost performance and nearly double your framerate[/b], making the game smoother to run on a wider range of PCs.[/p][p]NVIDIA DLSS settings are temporarily disabled, as the FSR is superior in this case.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/fbcc1a86ce524b403156065932131119639cd6c9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]📅 Playtest opening up in 24 hours![/h1][p][/p][p]Before the Demo is Officially released, it is going to the hands of [b]all registered Playtesters 24 hours after this announcement goes live![/b] To discuss the game and feedback, [b]join the New Acre Games Discord Community![/b] Link available on the Steam Store Page![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/1e4ffe23dcf47a460900e5c591a62b09fc7e5547.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]📅 Demo Coming Next Week[/h1][p]On top of today’s Playtest update, you won’t have to wait long to play Hillshade Farm! The [b]free demo launches in just 10 days![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/c428289537b6ab87ba16ecbb17c1eebcc092c411.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]💬 A Word From Developer[/h3][p]Your feedback has been incredible so far, and this update wouldn’t exist without the community. Every bug report and every idea helps us shape Hillshade Farm into the cozy, vibrant farming experience we’re aiming for.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting the project! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on this update, and to welcome even more of you when the demo goes live next week! 🌱🚜[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/b305a51f905188bb535c427a6e76065e6a5e0252.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Thanks so much for taking the time to catch up and see you very soon![/i][/p][p][i]New Acre Games[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hillshade Farm is Almost Ready for Its first Rollout! 🌾🐎
notes.notes: [p]Hello everybody!! [/p][p]It’s time for an update on the Development of Hillshade Farm and some exciting news![/p][p][/p][h2]Big news from the farm![/h2][p]We’ve entered the [b]final polishing phase [/b]for Early Access and the Demo, and most of the core systems are now in place! This also means that there's a new trailer in the making! :)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]What's new?[/h3][p]One of the biggest new additions?[/p][p][/p][h1][b]🐴 [/b]Horse riding![/h1][p]You can now explore your land on horseback, making travel smoother, faster, and way more immersive. Explore hills and valleys, and enjoy the beautiful nature vibes of Hillshade Farm! [/p][p][/p][p][b]How does it work?[/b] [/p][p]Horse can be purchased at the Animal Market, and currently is the most expensive animal in the game. There is a variety of horses looks-wise, where you can choose from plenty of horse breeds![/p][p]Like all animals in Hillshade Farm, horses have an Advanced AI system, meaning you [i]will[/i] have to take care of your horse, just as if you went and got yourself a horse in real life! [/p][p]These systems are still in polishing phase, and will be showcased soon in more depth. :)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/7060c6260d1a442fce25b67763719a762a6a0618.png"][/img][/p][p][i]*captured in game using build in photo mode.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]New Main Area! Kindale Village[/h1][p][/p][p]A [b]village[/b] has been added to the map, with new areas where you’ll be able to [b]sell your products[/b] and interact with the world more meaningfully.[/p][p]It is still in production phase, and will be included in Early Access only. More content on it coming soon! Villagers, Life, Unique Trades, Interactions and Stories and much more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/3e54bc8197c007bdba90001360db0ae90fbe9571.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Player House Customization[/h1][p][/p][p]The [b]player house is fully customizable[/b]; change the entire look, upgrade it, and [b]decorate it freely[/b] using a huge library of items. Make it truly yours.[/p][p][/p][p]All exterior and interior changes can be made, with tons of options to change the looks of every part of the house. [/p][p]Other changes can be made by acquiring items that you can place freely, such as furniture, devices and decorations![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/73c1c512f8504a937e2c0f3863a4cef277ee5008.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With most systems in place, the focus now is on polish, balancing, and small touches that bring the whole experience to life. [/p][p]This will be the most fun phase, where we will see drastic changes in each aspect of the game as everything is about to be tied together! To celebrate, We’re planning to release the [b]Playtest version in just 10 days[/b], with a [b]full demo coming in August[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][i]If you wish to join the Playtest, send your email address to[/i] [url="https://newacregames@gmail.com"]newacregames@gmail.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who's been supporting Hillshade Farm; your energy and feedback are a huge part of what keeps this project moving. 💚[/p][p]See you on the farm soon![/p][p][/p][p][i]New Acre Games[/i][/p]

notes.title: Pets, Landscape, POIs, Economy, and more content!
notes.notes:
[h1]🐾 Kittens, Crops, New Places & Content Galore![/h1]

[i]Hey everyone!

It's been a busy last few weeks, and it’s time for another update on Hillshade Farm!
There's been lots of improvement and progress made with the Farm Pets, New Crops and New Points of Interest on the Map! [/i]

Lets dive in! 

[h2]🐱 Say Hello to Cats and Kittens![/h2]
Our pet system is expanding! Alongside your loyal puppy companion, you can now discover and adopt adorable cats which can give birth to Kittens! 

The grown up cats have a fully realistic AI, meaning they ignore you most of the time unless they need something, catching rodents, sleeping, and getting stuck in craziest places. [i]I call it FCES - Full Cat Experience System. Just kidding lol, but I didn't lie! 
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/246e416cad1a19d23f5efe4d200dd07a4f2f5534.png[/img]


[h2]🌄 World Polish - A World That Looks & Feels Alive[/h2]
The landscape has been reworked across the entire map!

There has been major work done to the Map and the Landscape, with new biomes on North Side, beautiful Waterfalls and Rivers, Lakes, Mountains and Forests. 
As well as new Locations to visit which will all be unveiled in the New Trailer and Screenshots coming this month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/9aee405d53d10619a562bebbbc07b476e5a174cf.png[/img]


[h2]🛒 Economy & Market System[/h2]
The economy is growing! You can now:

Sell your produce, animal goods, and crafted items, buy seeds, saplings, tools, upgrades and much much more at various POIs on the Map. Every item has a purpose. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/59ee8deb5c3b3bfb8467a32a69bf93bcc7ecdc7d.png[/img]


[h2]🌱 Every Crop is Now in the Game![/h2]
That’s right! All planned crops are now fully functional and plantable!

Each with unique visuals, growth cycles, and sell values, care for them, water them, and watch your farm thrive. Learn more about plants and how they behave. [i]Be careful to plant in correct Seasons and make it to the Harvest Line! 
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/b3d736a98ab2546f5431cae44d53a7d05d5dbaa1.png[/img]




[h3]🎯 What’s Next?[/h3]
[i]With the core systems in place, we’re shifting focus to:[/i]

[b]Refining animal behaviors, refining the Map and other Locations & preparing for the Demo release this August! 

Together with it a new Trailer this month, showing all the pieces of the game, as well as new screenshots!![/b]

[i]We’re so close to letting you all step onto the farm and feel the magic for yourself.



Thanks again for all your support!!! Wishlists, kind comments, and excitement keep this world growing.

Until next time,
New Acre Games[/i]

notes.title: Life on the farm keeps getting better!
notes.notes:
[h1]Life on the farm keeps getting better!
[/h1]

Hey everyone!

[i]Time to share a quick update on what we’ve been working on.
The farm is starting to feel truly alive, and there's so many different experiences and things to do![/i]

[i]Big additions:[/i]

[h2]🐶 Full in-depth pet system[/h2]
A loyal puppy now joins your journey. It follows you, and lives for you. But that's not all. You can teach your puppy various skills through in-game training sessions!

[i]Your loyal companion will also protect you, guard your farm, grow up and develop a personality! With age and experience unlock epic skills like Herding or Hunting! Various additional dog breeds will be added soon :)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/cb4715988052ecb29adde0a3b48b9c601eff946a.png[/img]

[h2]🐱 Realistic farm Cats[/h2]
Cats are finally in. They roam the area, nap in the sun, and take care of anything that isn't supposed to be on the farm!
[i]Cats are more independent than dogs, and they will usually take care of themselves. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/2597b275ee31fbf2a6373945a1a8f4318813d228.png[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Animated Crafting[/h2]
Crafting is deeper and fully animated. Whether you’re building, cooking, or creating: everything now feels responsive, satisfying, and real.
[i]There are 5 different crafting mechanics in the game; Handwork, Woodwork, Assembly, Smelting and Cooking! Each Crafting action is fully animated to achieve full immersion.[/i]

[i]The game offers 100s of crafting recipes to unlock and use all over your farm![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/8ebc437aa25d0e570ca06667a4d245a6e6a019d9.png[/img]


[h2]🔧Power sources and real-life logic[/h2]
Everything on the farm needs care. Refill, maintain, keep it running.
From lights to sprinklers, each object is tied into the mainline.

[i]Lights need a power source and a switch to work, and sprinklers need a power source and water source to work! The farm lives only with you.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/4f94d91c04174b154f26509fce27caf892cca08e.png[/img]


Thanks so much for being here! Every update brings us closer to the game we’ve dreamed of building. A new trailer is on the way, the demo is getting close, and we’re pouring everything we’ve got into making this world feel alive, meaningful, and worth your time.

Make sure to Wishlist the game, it really means a lot, and check out our Tiktok and YT channels to see more behind the scenes content!

Thanks once again, for being here since the beginning! 💚
New Acre Games

notes.title: A New Name, Same Heart: Welcome to Hillshade Farm!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to share an exciting change with you! Our game now has a new name: Hillshade Farm!


This isn’t just a cosmetic change. Hillshade Farm better captures the atmosphere, tone, and spirit of the game we’re building. A realistic, immersive yet relaxing and rewarding experience. It's not just about chores, numbers and stats, it is about learning, growing and feeling the Farm Life!

Why the change?
As the game grew, so did its identity. We wanted a name that evokes:

🌄 [i]The peaceful beauty of the landscape[/i]
🐾 [i]The emotional connection to your animals and the farm[/i]
🛠️ [i]The handcrafted, nostalgic charm in this Open World.[/i]

We believe Hillshade Farm does just that, and more.

What’s next?
The name change will be reflected across our store page, trailer, artwork, and social channels. If you’ve been following along already, thank you! Nothing else changes in terms of development, vision, or timeline.

In fact… this is just the beginning. We’ve got big things coming:

📽️ [i]Official Trailer (dropping very soon!)[/i]
🎨 [i]New art, screenshots & updates[/i]
🗓️ [i]A release roadmap[/i]


Thanks for being here from the start. We can't wait to welcome you to Hillshade Farm. 🧡

- New Acre

notes.title: The Farm Just Leveled Up.
notes.notes:
[h1]The Farm Grows – Pets, Trucks, Renovations & More![/h1]

Hey everyone 👋
Development has been moving fast, and the farm’s really starting to come alive.

[i]Here’s a look at what’s new in Farm Life Simulator:[/i]


[h2]🐾 Your new best friend – the German Shepherd[/h2]
You’re not alone out here anymore.

A loyal German Shepherd now lives on your farm. He follows you, protects you, and this place feels much less empty with him around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/d8b3b7cef9d308585de561b9b32b09bde270f938.png[/img]



But he’s not just there to look good — we’re adding a full pet system:

🧠 Train your dog to follow, stay, herd animals, and fetch dropped items
🐕 Unlock new skills over time as your bond grows
🏠 Build a dog house that acts as his home base
💛 And yes, you can pet him. Anytime. That’s the rule.



[h2]🚗 The old Pickup Truck – yours to restore and drive[/h2]
Out front sits a rusty, beat-up pickup, one of the first things you’ll see when you inherit the land.
You can now:

🔧 Restore it piece by piece 
🎨 Customize the paint, plate, and style
⛽ Maintain it with fuel and parts
🚙 Use it for transport, or just cruising across the farm
🎮 And yes, it feels SO good to drive. Weighty, smooth, responsive with perfect physics simulation. You’ll want to take it for a spin even when you don’t need to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/bee03dea18c7d44d787e1c6dfbfcd38e9e503fe2.png[/img]

[h2]🏪 Animal Market & Farmer Store[/h2]
The economy is finally opening up — and you’ve got places to visit.

🐄 Choose over 15 different animals at the Animal Market
🛻 Animals are delivered to your pen, or picked up with your truck
🌱 Visit the Farmer Store to get seeds, tools, upgrades, and rare items
💸 Sell your goods to earn money and reinvest in your farm

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/421a9373f1686924d8e1233110e4ddb1b9522162.png[/img]



[h2]🛠️ Barn Renovation System[/h2]
That old barn on your land? You can now fix it — one wall, beam, and floorboard at a time. 
[list]
[*]Hammer in nails
[*]Replace rotten wood
[*]Paint, upgrade, and customize the final look
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/d383926a723639a3c0306f9c5b8fa7bcf76fbbb5.png[/img]
[i]This is just the start of the full renovation system, which will extend to the house, coop, sheds, and more.[/i]



[h2]🎨 New UI & Interaction Polish[/h2]
We’ve reworked the UI to feel cleaner, faster, and easier to navigate.

[list]
[*]Full Redesign to a hand-drawn Farmer Notebook Menus 
[*]More recipes for crafting added
[*]Animal Purchase Menus are changed to in-game Market (Animal Market)
[*]Inventory & interaction improvements
[*]Tooltips, highlights, expanded notification systems
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539911/ec241e399a1dbfc372edca18dacb75832420661d.png[/img]

Still simple — [b]just better in every way.[/b]



[h3]This update is a big one. And it’s just the beginning.[/h3]

More animals. More systems. More freedom to build your farm.

And if you haven’t wishlisted [i]Farm Life Simulator[/i] yet… you know what to do 😉
Thanks for being here.
More soon.

[i]New Acre Games[/i] 💛

notes.title: 🎬 New Teaser Trailer is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve just released our very first official teaser trailer for Farm Life Simulator — and we’re excited to finally show a glimpse of the world we’re building! 

This is still very early in development, and there’s a lot more to come. The trailer highlights some of the core systems, but many things will be improved, polished, and expanded over time.

💬 We’ve already received some great feedback from players — including valuable thoughts on the current UI.
Thanks to that, we’ve started working on a full UI redesign to better match the realistic and cozy atmosphere of the game. More on that soon!

🎥 Watch the teaser on the store page and let us know what you think — and if you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist the game. Your support means the world to us.

Thanks for being here from the start!
— New Acre Games 🚜💚


[i]TRIMMER TOOL[/i]
